2. Unless they are injured.

The first part can be symbolized as L • H, where L represents "live long lives" and H represents "are happy creatures".

The second part can be symbolized as ¬I, where ¬ represents "not" and I represents "injured".

A. (L • H) ≡ I: This option is incorrect because it implies that living long lives and being happy creatures are equivalent to being injured, which is not the case.

B. (L • H) ∨ I: This option is incorrect because it implies that turtles live long lives and are happy creatures, or they are injured, which is not the correct interpretation of the sentence.
